rules.definition: Dirichlet(alpha0=1) propensity with exponential forgetting w=0.5**(age/30), age 0 = newest past draw; ticket = 11 lowest (alpha0+c_i)/(22*alpha0+sum c); ties -> smaller number.
Per-number Bernoulli BOCPD (Adams-MacKay), constant hazard 1/50, Beta(1,1) segment prior, exact (untruncated) run-length recursion; ticket = 11 lowest posterior predictive P(drawn next).

Plackett-Luce on full draw order (11 sequential picks from 22), MAP with theta_i~N(0,0.1^2), Newton to |grad|<1e-10, all past draws equal weight; ticket = 11 lowest theta_i (= lowest plug-in inclusion prob).
